description: Create the White Edition GNOME Shell extension that adds a fixed bottom-left Start button whose Start-menu popup opens left/center/right per a GSettings key, with a selectable Ubuntu-themed Start-button logo (3 candidate SVGs) and a prefs UI. This is the 'supported Shell extension/customization layer' the White Edition README already calls for. Entirely additive; does not touch vendored upstream GNOME source. Independent of FEAT-002 (docs) except that FEAT-002 documents this.
steps: Create directory gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ and subdirs schemas/ and logos/.

Write metadata.json: uuid 'white-edition@mearvk' (MUST match the directory name), name 'Ubuntu White Edition Panel', description referencing the fixed bottom-left Start button and configurable popup alignment, shell-version array targeting GNOME 46 (e.g. ["46","47"]; state the chosen version), settings-schema 'org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition'.

Write schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition.gschema.xml: schema id 'org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition', path '/org/gnome/shell/extensions/white-edition/'. Define enum type for alignment (values left, center, right) and key 'start-menu-alignment' defaulting to 'left' with a <summary>/<description>. Define enum for logo (values circle-of-friends, mono-accent, focus-ring) and key 'start-button-logo' defaulting to one candidate. Must compile clean with glib-compile-schemas --strict.

Create 3 candidate SVG logos in logos/ following ubuntu-white/icons SVG conventions (viewBox, role=img, aria-label, flat fills, no gradients/gloss). Palette: accent #e95420, chrome #303030, surfaces #ffffff/#f7f7f7, borders #d6d6d6/#dddddd. (a) circle-of-friends.svg: Circle-of-Friends-style mark in #e95420 on a rounded #f7f7f7 chip; (b) mono-accent.svg: minimal monochrome #303030 start glyph with a small #e95420 accent dot; (c) focus-ring.svg: Circle-of-Friends-style outline in #303030 with an #e95420 focus ring. Design to read at 16/24/32/48 px. Each must be xmllint-clean.

Write extension.js using modern GJS ESM imports (import GObject/St/Clutter from 'gi://...'; import * as Main from 'resource:///org/gnome/shell/ui/main.js'; import {Extension} from 'resource:///org/gnome/shell/extensions/extension.js'; PanelMenu.Button and PopupMenu from resource paths). On enable(): read settings via this.getSettings(); add a PanelMenu.Button to Main.panel at the LEFT box (Main.panel.addToStatusArea with position 0, or insert into _leftBox) so the Start button is ALWAYS bottom-left regardless of alignment; set the button icon from the selected logo file (Gio.icon_new_for_string on the extension's logos/<name>.svg path). Build the Start menu as the button's PopupMenu. Implement alignment: reposition the menu boxpointer horizontally based on start-menu-alignment (left near button, center on primary monitor work area, right at right edge) by overriding the menu's _boxPointer.setSourceAlignment / arrowSide and setting the actor x within Main.uiGroup, or by using a St.BoxLayout popup positioned in Main.layoutManager. Connect settings 'changed::start-menu-alignment' and 'changed::start-button-logo' to reposition/reload live. On disable(): destroy the button, disconnect signals, null out settings per current extension lifecycle rules. Add clarifying comments where live-reposition depends on Shell internals that cannot be verified in-sandbox.

Write prefs.js using ExtensionPreferences and Adw/Gtk4 (import Adw, Gtk, Gio from gi://; export default class extends ExtensionPreferences; fillPreferencesWindow builds an Adw.PreferencesPage with an Adw.ComboRow bound to start-menu-alignment (Left/Center/Right) and an Adw.ComboRow bound to start-button-logo (the 3 candidates), using settings.bind or a change handler). This makes the settings appear in GNOME Extensions / Control Center.

Write stylesheet.css for the extension, consuming the White Edition palette values (mirror theme/white-edition.css: white surface, #303030 text, #dddddd edges, #e95420 accent) for the Start button and popup. Keep restrained/flat per White Edition quality rules.

Write install.sh mirroring theme/install-icons.sh conventions: '#!/usr/bin/env bash', 'set -euo pipefail', require an absolute TARGET_ROOT containing /etc, reject symlinks/special files in the extension source, copy the extension into $TARGET_ROOT/usr/share/gnome-shell/extensions/white-edition@mearvk/ with install -m 0644 (0755 for install.sh not needed in target), then compile the schema with glib-compile-schemas on the installed schemas dir. Never delete unrelated files. Print a completion line like the other installers.

Run static validation and record findings in the feature file: node --check extension.js; node --check prefs.js; glib-compile-schemas --strict --dry-run schemas/; xmllint --noout on each SVG and the gschema.xml; bash -n install.sh; grep-confirm uuid==dirname, settings-schema==gschema id, and both keys are read in extension.js and prefs.js.
Commit on branch feat/white-edition-start-menu with a clear conventional-commit message (feat: ...). Do NOT commit any generated gschemas.compiled.
acceptance_criteria: Directory gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ contains metadata.json, extension.js, prefs.js, stylesheet.css, install.sh, schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition.gschema.xml, and logos/ with exactly 3 SVGs.
metadata.json uuid equals the directory name 'white-edition@mearvk' and settings-schema equals the gschema id.

glib-compile-schemas --strict on the schemas dir succeeds with no errors; the schema defines start-menu-alignment (enum left|center|right, default left) and start-button-logo (enum of the 3 candidates).
node --check passes on extension.js and prefs.js.
xmllint --noout passes on all 3 SVGs and the gschema.xml.
grep confirms the Start button is added at the panel left box unconditionally, and that only the popup position depends on start-menu-alignment.
No files under gnome-source/{glib,gtk,mutter,gnome-shell,...} vendored upstream trees are modified.
No em dashes in any prose written for this feature; no gschemas.compiled committed.
verification: for f in .../logos/*.svg .../schemas/*.gschema.xml; do xmllint --noout "$f"; done
grep -n 'start-menu-alignment' extension.js prefs.js; grep -n 'start-button-logo' extension.js prefs.js; grep -n 'white-edition@mearvk' metadata.json
findings:
Created additive White Edition GNOME Shell extension at gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ targeting GNOME Shell 46 (metadata shell-version ["46","47"], README states 46). Files: metadata.json, extension.js, prefs.js, stylesheet.css, install.sh, README.md, schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition.gschema.xml, and logos/ with exactly 3 SVGs (circle-of-friends.svg, mono-accent.svg, focus-ring.svg). extension.js adds the Start button to the panel LEFT box at position 0 unconditionally via Main.panel.addToStatusArea(this.uuid, this._button, 0, 'left') so it is always bottom-left; only the popup boxpointer x is repositioned by start-menu-alignment (left/center/right) against the primary monitor work area, applied on open-state-changed and on the changed:: signal. start-button-logo reloads the button St.Icon via Gio.icon_new_for_string on the logos/<nick>.svg path. prefs.js uses ExtensionPreferences + Adw.PreferencesPage/ComboRow bound to both keys. stylesheet.css mirrors the White Edition palette (#ffffff surface, #303030 text, #dddddd edge, #e95420 accent). install.sh mirrors theme/install-icons.sh conventions (set -euo pipefail, CDPATH cd, absolute TARGET_ROOT containing /etc, symlink/special-file rejection, install -m 0644, glib-compile-schemas on installed schemas dir, completion line) and does not commit any compiled schema.

Static validation results (exact):
- node --check extension.js: OK (run with env -u NODE_OPTIONS because the sandbox sets NODE_OPTIONS=--require .../proxy-bootstrap.js which otherwise aborts node startup; syntax valid).
- node --check prefs.js: OK (same env -u NODE_OPTIONS note).
- glib-compile-schemas --strict --dry-run schemas/: OK, no errors.
- xmllint --noout: clean on logos/circle-of-friends.svg, logos/focus-ring.svg, logos/mono-accent.svg, and schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition.gschema.xml.
- bash -n install.sh: OK.
- grep confirms: dirname 'white-edition@mearvk' == metadata uuid 'white-edition@mearvk'; metadata settings-schema 'org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition' == gschema schema id; both start-menu-alignment and start-button-logo are read in extension.js and prefs.js; button added at panel 'left' box (line 156).
- No em dashes (grep -P \x{2014} found none). No gschemas.compiled present. No vendored upstream files modified (only the new shell-extension/ tree is untracked).

Could NOT be verified in-sandbox (no running GNOME Shell, gnome-extensions CLI absent): live popup repositioning against BoxPointer internals (_boxPointer.setArrowOrigin/set_x), live GSettings binding behavior, and prefs Adw/Gtk4 rendering. The alignment geometry math is applied against the primary monitor work area and clamped; a clarifying comment marks the Shell-internal dependency. node --check validates syntax only and does not resolve gi:// / resource:/// imports (expected).

REVIEW-FIX (iteration 1, addressing 2026-09-01-023346-review.md NEEDS_CHANGES):

Issue 1 (popup alignment was a no-op): FIXED. Root cause confirmed against vendored gnome-shell 46 source: js/ui/popupMenu.js open() calls super.open() (emits 'open-state-changed', where the old handler ran) BEFORE _boxPointer.setPosition(sourceActor, _arrowAlignment); the final origin is then computed in js/ui/boxpointer.js vfunc_allocate -> _reposition(box), which ends with allocationBox.set_origin(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y)). So the old actor.set_x() on the open signal was clobbered on the same open cycle. New approach: extension.js no longer connects open-state-changed for alignment. Instead _installAlignmentOverride() wraps the popup boxpointer instance's _reposition method: it calls the original _reposition first (so the Shell owns origin/arrowSide/arrowOrigin), then _applyHorizontalAlignment() shifts only the allocationBox X for center/right (left leaves the Shell default). Because the wrapper runs inside _reposition on every allocation, the aligned X is the authoritative value and is not overwritten. The clamp reuses the same [workarea.x + padding .. workarea.x + workarea.width - (padding + natWidth)] range the Shell uses (padding = -arrow-rise theme length), and the stage->parent coordinate translation mirrors _reposition's transform_stage_point walk. The changed::start-menu-alignment handler now just calls boxPointer.queue_relayout() when open, so the wrapped _reposition re-applies with the new value.

Issue 2 (setArrowOrigin given a Gravity enum): FIXED. Removed the actor.setArrowOrigin(Clutter.Gravity.SOUTH_WEST) call entirely; the boxpointer's own _reposition sets a correct integer arrow origin. The now-unused 'import Clutter from gi://Clutter' was dropped (grep confirms zero Clutter references in extension.js; node --check still passes).

Issue 3 ('bottom-left' inaccurate): FIXED (prose). The code only adds to the panel left box (top-left on a stock panel) and does not move the panel to the bottom, so all 'bottom-left' claims were changed to 'left of the panel' / 'panel left box' in: metadata.json description, both gschema key <description>s, db/local.d/00-white-edition comment, extension.js comments, this extension's README.md (also clarified 'the panel left box, the top-left on a stock GNOME panel'), prefs.js group description, and the parent conf/white-edition/README.md (also clarified the extension does not itself relocate the panel to the bottom). grep confirms no 'bottom-left' remains under conf/white-edition/. Bottom panel placement was NOT implemented (larger separate Shell-layout concern the parent README already flags); prose no longer overstates.

Issue 4 (runtime unverified): acknowledged and unchanged. Static checks re-run after the fix all pass (env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check extension.js and prefs.js; glib-compile-schemas --strict --dry-run schemas/; xmllint --noout on gschema and all 3 SVGs; bash -n install.sh). node --check is syntax-only and does not resolve resource:/// imports; live popup anchoring, GSettings binding, and Adw/Gtk4 prefs rendering still cannot be exercised without a running Shell 46 session and should be confirmed there. The new mechanism is argued correct against the vendored Shell 46 reposition/allocation cycle above. disable() still cleans up: it now also restores the boxpointer's original _reposition (removing our wrapper) in addition to disconnecting the settings signals, nulling _settings, and destroying the actor. No em dashes in any authored/modified prose (the only em dashes under conf/white-edition are in pre-existing theme/* files not touched here). No vendored upstream files modified.
